findings.current: something big and thick flew through his vision, bleached white with pain, and slapped him across the cheek.
findings.defect: The phrasing makes it sound as though the thing flying through his vision was bleached white. The Korean says pain whitened his vision, and the thing appeared within it.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly attributes the whiteness to his vision being flooded by pain (고통으로 인해 새하얗게 물든 시야 속에서), not to the object.
findings.replacement: As the young man curled up and groaned, his vision bleached white with pain. Something big and thick flew into it and slapped him across the cheek.

findings.current: the Chief Escort she’d trusted like family nearly let the Zhongnan Sect take the Yongbong Escort Bureau
findings.defect: “Let” can imply the Chief Escort knowingly permitted the takeover. The source says the bureau nearly fell to the Zhongnan Sect because of the Chief Escort, without establishing deliberate permission.
findings.rationale: The source uses a passive construction with the Chief Escort as the cause (총표두에 의해 ... 뺏길 뻔하고); it does not state that the Chief Escort let the takeover happen intentionally.
findings.replacement: the Yongbong Escort Bureau nearly fell to the Zhongnan Sect because of the Chief Escort she’d trusted like family

summary: Two minor fidelity issues: one ambiguous physical image and one added implication about the Chief Escort’s intent.
